title: TX queue C conformance: validate behavioral vector cases
description: Robustness review of the new B.2 C vector generator found that it opens tx_queue_bounded.json and tx_queue_implementation.json but consumes only the bounded capacity and ENOBUFS constant. Changes to canonical preemption, same/lower-priority backpressure, expiry, FIFO pop order, or implementation-contract expectations would not affect the generated header or fail CTest. Validate the named behavioral cases and expected outcomes while generating the header so every required vector file is a meaningful build oracle.
acceptance_criteria: gen_vectors.py validates named bounded and implementation cases for priority values, deadlines, preemption victim/action, same/lower-priority rejection, expiry action/stat, FIFO priority order, ENOBUFS, deadline-before-capacity ordering, and oldest-lowest preemption; malformed or divergent vectors fail generation with a clear error; normal generation and sanitizer-backed CTest pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
